create_LogitsProcessorWithLoRA: create a LogitsProcessorWithLoRA instance wrapping a base LogitsProcessor with LoRA adapter support
build_create_lora_weights: build LoRA weight tensors (lora_a_stacked and lora_b_stacked) for a given max_loras and lora_config
set_lora_weights: set LoRA adapter weights into the stacked lora_a and lora_b tensors at a given index
reset_lora_adapter: reset LoRA weights at a given index by zeroing lora_a_stacked and lora_b_stacked entries
run_forward_logits: run forward pass to compute logits with LoRA applied on hidden states through the base layer
review_can_replace_layer: review the can_replace_layer classmethod that always returns False for LogitsProcessor replacement
